messages:
Ava: T-minus 2h for the lightswitch deploy. Quick checklist:
- who is smoke lead?
- who has rollback creds (DB + infra)?
- any last-minute blockers?
Plan: canary 5% for 10m, monitor errors/latency, then stagger to 50% -> 100% if green.
Deploy window: 14:00-15:00 UTC. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lightswitch-rollback

Chandler: I can take rollback creds for infra (k8s + routing). I won't be the smoke lead though. I'll be on pager.

Ben: I can own smoke. Will run the checklist and post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

Priya: Quick Q on smoke tests — do we want the full prod-like traffic replay or a trimmed set? Also confirm DB migration is no-op.

Ava: Good Q. Use trimmed set focused on high-throughput endpoints + auth flows. DB migration is zero-downtime but it does add an index build; should be fine but monitor DB replica lag.

Ben: Got it. Smoke checklist I'll run:
1) sanity end-to-end on /api/generate
2) auth login + token refresh
3) embeddings route check
4) tail logs for errors > 5xx
I'll ping with pass/fail.

QA-Alex: I'll kick the replay at T+20m for extra coverage (low concurrency). If anything weird I'll flag immediately.

Chandler: rollback steps (short):
1) scale down new deployment: kubectl -n prod set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:previous
2) revert routing: /ops/routing rollback-lightswitch
3) run db rollback script if migration fails: /ops/db/rollback.sh
Ensure you have sudo on the jumpbox.

DevOps-Bot: Scheduled deploy job created: job_id=deploy-3345678901, window=2026-03-17T14:00:00Z. Notifying ops channel at T-15m.

Priya: I have DB creds and will watch replica lag. Will also verify KMS rotations post-deploy.

Ben: Smoke checklist run at T+7m: all checks passed except a transient 502 on the embeddings route (~30s) — recovered. Posting logs snippet:
```
[14:07:12Z] embeddings: 502 gateway timeout -> healthy 14:07:44
```

Ava: Thanks. Decision time at T-30m: we are green on owners and rollback plan, smoke lead confirmed, QA coverage set. I'm marking this thread as "ready" unless any objections.

Chandler: No objections. I'll be standing by for rollback if needed.

Priya: Ready. Will escalate to infra if replica lag > 5s or CPU > 80%.

Ben: Ready and monitoring. Will post final smoke pass at T+25m.

Ava: OK launching canary at 14:00 UTC. If anyone sees >2% error spike or latency >200ms sustained for >2min, hit the rollback play.
